items.title: UNH Leads Its Peer Group. You Pay For That
items.summary: In the health insurance arena, one company is both the undisputed leader and the most expensive ticket, forcing investors to decide if paying up for quality is a winning strategy.

items.title: Earnings Have Been Excellent. Why Stocks Aren’t Showing It.
items.summary: A mix of high expectations, profit-taking, and a slight dip in valuations has sent S&P 500 stocks sputtering even after solid earnings reports.

items.title: Oscar Health Stock Falls After Earnings Beat and Guidance Hike
items.summary: Oscar Health’s medical loss ratio—the percentage of premium revenue spent on medical claims—fell to 79.2% from 91.1%,

items.title: Healthcare Stocks Have Been Forgotten. Eli Lilly, McKesson, and 9 More to Buy.
items.summary: A few sectors have dominated the market this year, and healthcare isn’t one of them. Many stocks in the sector look ready to gain.

items.title: The Case For UnitedHealth Stock Is Margin, Not Growth
items.summary: UnitedHealth's revenue held up; the operating margin on it did not, and closing that gap is the whole upside case.

items.title: CVS Stock Slides On 2027 Outlook Despite Hearty Earnings Beat
items.summary: CVS Health earnings surged past tepid forecasts as health benefit costs fell as a share of premiums.  CVS stock initially jumped but reversed sharply lower.  Management's 2027 outlook shared on the earnings call may have been the trigger.

items.title: Jefferies downgrades Cigna to Hold on mounting 2027 earnings headwinds
items.summary: Investing.com -- Jefferies downgraded Cigna to Hold from Buy, arguing that a growing list of earnings headwinds and limited catalysts outweigh the stock's discounted valuation, while cutting its price target to $307 from $336.
